name: Onboarding / content collection
when: You have no logo, photos or copy ready.
covers: Extra calls, follow-ups, and gathering your information for you.

name: Extra revision round
when: You want changes beyond the rounds included in your package.
covers: A full round of changes. Charged per round, not per change — so one round can hold as many notes as you like.

name: Rush delivery
when: You need the site faster than the standard 1–2 week turnaround.
covers: Your project moves to the front of the queue.
